topic.title: Conversation History Preferences
topic.shortdesc: Configure how the title and the description of each conversation are generated in the chat history.

body.p: The Conversation History preferences page is available in Options Preferences Plugins Oxygen AI Positron Conversation History . It contains the following options:

dlentry.dt: Automatically generate conversation title and description using AI

dd.p: When this option is selected (the default), the AI generates, in the background, the title and the description that identify a conversation in the chat history. They are generated from the first message you send and are written in the same language as that message. A title has at most 50 characters.
For a conversation started by running an action, the title and the description are generated from the action and the content it was run on.

Until the AI returns the title and the description, the conversation is listed with its first message. If this option is not selected, the first message is used as both the title and the description. You can rename a conversation at any time from the chat history.

dlentry.dd: Specifies the AI model that generates the titles and the descriptions. It is available only when the option above is selected. The drop-down list contains the models of all the enabled connections, including the AI Positron Service models when the service is enabled. If no model was chosen, or the chosen one is no longer available, the model currently used by the chat is used.
